newsitem.title: BRAZIL: IMF team to arrive in Brazil on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: IMF team to arrive in Brazil on Wednesday.

text.p: A team of officials from the International Monetary Fund (IMF) is due to arrive in Brazil on Wednesday to take stock of the country's economy, Pedro Parente, the Finance Ministry's executive secretary, said.

The IMF, which has no formal economic program with Brazil, has already completed one fact-finding mission to Brasilia this year, but the Brazilian governent suggested officials return to receive up-to-date economic data, Parente told reporters.
Larger-than-expected deficits in Brazil's trade and public sector accounts meant the country was in a "complex" economic situation, but "everything is under control," he said.
